review.finding: Draft review asked for varying receive patterns, addressed with phase/order, zero-extension and flag tests. The retained discrepancies were then traced to an ISA defect and a firmware defect, both fixed.
review.result: All 16 model test groups pass. UART conforms to the platform oracle, autobaud measures exactly, SPI mode 0 runs full duplex, and ruff is clean across tools/ and sw/pemu/.

development_failures: First test run failed because UART harness omitted assembly constants; harness corrected to assemble the complete unchanged firmware file.
Retiming broke 8 of 14 model tests whose expectations encoded the 1+D rule; each expected value was rederived from max(D,1) rather than adjusted until it passed.
Seven ruff findings in check_axpe_model.py (six late-binding closures and one import position) were fixed rather than suppressed.

Adding clocked shifts broke the reject test, because an unclocked zero-period shift is well defined under max(D,1) and was no longer an error; the case was moved to the supported set rather than the model being made to keep rejecting it.

superseded_findings.note: The draft slice recorded these as expected discrepancies rather than tuning the expectations to match. That is what made the defect findable, so the finding is kept rather than deleted.

uart.s.observation: all transitions after the start edge were two cycles late

autobaud.s.observation: measured 18 and 51 cycles for known 20- and 53-cycle low pulses

root_causes: ISA defect: a 1+D retirement rule makes a bit cell BAUD+1 cycles, so no firmware can place an edge on a multiple of the bit period. The rule is now max(D,1): D is the cell duration and every instruction occupies at least one cycle. This accounted for both UART cycles and one autobaud cycle.

Firmware defect: autobaud.s had a branch between its two WAITEs, spending a cycle the measurement could not see. The timeout check now follows both waits. This accounted for the second autobaud cycle.

decisions.clocked_cell: Splits at the half point: data at the cell start, or on the leading edge when cpha=1; clock leading edge at D/2, returning to cpol at D; cpha selects the sampling edge. cpol/cpha give SPI modes 0-3.
decisions.odd_periods: A clocked period must be even and non-zero. Flooring would give an asymmetric duty cycle the listing no longer states, so it is refused.
decisions.pin_aliasing: din == dout is legal and is what I2C's SDA is. A clock sharing a pin with either data line, or on an input-only pin, is refused.
decisions.enforcement: All three are machine rejects before issue, consuming no cycle. SHCFG is loaded from a register, so the configuration is invisible at assembly time and the assembler cannot catch them.
